webdav.title: WebDAV access
webdav.description: Mount completed downloads via WebDAV to browse and play them directly from your file manager or video player. Credentials are created and managed in the Settings page.
webdav.credentialsHint: WebDAV usernames and access tokens are generated in the Settings page. Issue a separate credential per device and revoke individually at any time.
webdav.noteReadOnly: This gateway is <accent>read-only</accent>. Upload, delete, and rename are not supported.
webdav.noteBasicAuth: Only Basic auth is enabled — put it behind an HTTPS reverse proxy if exposed publicly.
webdav.notePathSame: The path layout matches the Downloaded page, grouped by anime and subtitle group.

macos.title: macOS Finder
macos.step1: In Finder press ⌘ + K to open Connect to Server
macos.step3: When prompted, enter the username and access token you created in Settings

windows.title: Windows File Explorer
windows.step1: Right-click This PC → Add a network location
windows.step3: Provide the username and access token from Settings when prompted

mobile.title: Mobile players (Infuse / VLC / nPlayer, etc.)
mobile.step1: Add a new source of type WebDAV server
mobile.step3: Use the username and access token from Settings
